eiss.title: EISS is not 24/7
eiss.body: Early Intervention Support Services usually run during business hours. Check the hours on each listing.

pes.title: We do not call PES
pes.body: Volunteers never call a Psychiatric Screening Center (PES) directly. Callers can call PES themselves. PES always arrives with the police, and mobile outreach only covers the county where the center is located. PES is for ages 18 and up. If the caller is a child, offer PerformCare at 1-877-652-7624.
pes.banner: PES always arrives with the police. Callers can call PES themselves.
